FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ProBuild Supply Company specializes in the wholesale distribution of building materials and supplies for construction projects. Our core operations include sourcing high-quality products such as lumber, drywall, insulation, roofing materials, and various other construction essentials from reputable manufacturers. We maintain a robust inventory across our secure warehouse facilities, which are equipped with fire prevention measures, including fire alarms and extinguishers, to ensure the safety of our materials. Our experienced team is dedicated to providing exceptional customer service, offering timely deliveries, and maintaining compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations regarding the storage and transportation of building supplies. Additionally, we conduct regular safety audits and employee training to continually enhance our risk management practices and ensure a safe working environment.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 1, 2023, a fire occurred in our warehouse due to an electrical fault, resulting in a loss of $2,500 for damaged inventory. The damage was mitigated by our fire prevention measures, and we received the insurance payout. The matter is now resolved. On May 15, 2023, we experienced theft of materials valued at $2,500 during a break-in. We have since improved our security protocols and are actively pursuing recovery through local law enforcement.
